root_text: @RVCJ_FB Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) case in India: Symptoms include cough, fever, nasal congestion. To stay safe, wash hands, wear masks, avoid close contact with sick people, and sanitize surfaces. Awareness is key to prevention.
